messages:
Ava: Quick compact check — I want a tiny status update for the Q2 mile markers so I can roll this into the exec snapshot. Reply with one line like 'shipped/parked/follow-up: <owner>' for your row. Pasting my table below for context.

```
1) Model routing v1 — owner: Liam
2) Autoscaler v2 — owner: Priya
3) Canary rollback flow — owner: Noah
4) Docs + SDK snippets — owner: Marta
5) Billing meter fix — owner: Sanaa
```

Liam: shipped: Model routing v1 — rolled to prod yesterday, routing heuristic change lowered steady-state latency. :shipit:

Priya: parked: Autoscaler v2 — blocked on cloud quota increase for new instance types. Filed INC-452 and added mitigation (fallback to smaller batch sizes). @eng-infra please advise on quota bump or alternative.

Noah: follow-up: Canary rollback flow — pushed to staging; observed a race on state sync when multiple rollbacks overlap. I own a hotfix branch, ETA EOD tomorrow for e2e. Will post PR when ready.

Marta: follow-up: Docs + SDK snippets — draft PR waiting on Noah's hotfix so code examples are accurate. PR #678, reviewers @devex. Planning a small snippet refresh once rollback API stabilizes.

Sanaa: shipped: Billing meter fix — emergency patch deployed this morning, meter drift issue resolved, billing alerts quieted. Monitoring green.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy for canary-rollback-flow failed at 14:32 UTC with 503s during post-deploy smoke. Logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/4567 (brief).

Ava: Thanks, all. Liam — can you paste the perf deltas in thread (p50/p95)? Priya — link the quota ticket here. Noah — ping me when PR is up; we can steal one canary slot to validate after hotfix. I'll consolidate and send a one-paragraph update to exec.

Liam: perf: p50 from 210ms -> 170ms after routing tweak, p95 stays ~760ms. Full perf gist: https://gist.github.com/liam/perf-routing-v1

Priya: quota ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INC-452 assigned to @ram, notes on required vCPU and GPUs in the thread. Escalating if no response in 24h.

Noah: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/789 — hotfix branch ready, running e2e now. Will update when green.

Marta: Added release note stub to the docs PR, will update after Noah confirms.

Ava: Great — will collect these and send to exec. If anything slips beyond next-week ETA, call it out asap so we can re-prioritize. :thumbsup:
